messages:
Ravi: FYI ran onboarding probe for harbor-lite (fp16 -> int4). quick eval on msrar-10k shows recall@5 down ~3.8% and clusters smeared.
Ana: Oof. What quant pipeline? per-tensor or per-channel? any clipping?
Ravi: Default per-tensor symmetric with 0.995 clip via `tools/quantize --model harbor-lite --bits 4 --clip 0.995`.
Priya: Can you paste the exact eval CLI? I'll try to reproduce on my workstation.
Ravi: `tools/eval_embeddings --data datasets/msrar-10k --model /runs/harbor-lite/int4 --k 5 --metric recall --sim cosine --seed 2026 --batch 1024 --microbatch 128`
Jules: Microbatching might introduce small nondet differences. run with microbatch 64 and 256 to rule that out. Also try dot-product metric.
bench-bot: Job queued: job-4482 (per-channel int4, clip=0.995, calib_holdout=2k). ETA ~12m.
Ana: Per-channel usually helps with channel-wise scale mismatch. also try asymmetric integer mapping (unsigned) if activations skew positive.
Priya: Suggest median-norm rescale experiment: compute median norm of fp16 and int4, then multiply int4 embeddings by ratio and re-eval. quick script: `scripts/median_rescale.py --fp16 fp16.pkl --int4 int4.pkl --out int4_rescaled.pkl`
Ravi: Early numbers from per-tensor symmetric run:
```
SUMMARY: recall@5: fp16=0.651, int4=0.613
recall@10: fp16=0.804, int4=0.768
silhouette: fp16=0.19, int4=0.10
median_norm: fp16=3.42, int4=2.78
```
Ravi: Per-channel job started. hoping for closer match.
bench-bot: Job update: job-4482 completed -> results at /runs/harbor-lite/int4/per-channel/4482/results.json
Ravi: Per-channel brief: recall@5=0.637, recall@10=0.793, silhouette=0.16. better but still ~1.1% down at recall@10 vs fp16.
Ana: Looks like normalization gap is a major factor (median_norm diff). Priya's median-rescale might close most of it.
Priya: Ran median-rescale: int4 rescaled by 3.42/2.78 factor. re-eval: recall@5=0.645, recall@10=0.801, silhouette=0.18. closes gap for recall@10, small gap leftover at recall@5.
Jules: Great. That suggests global norm mismatch rather than severe topology change. next checks: (1) knn stability repeats (`knn --k 5 --repeats 10 --seed 7`) (2) UMAP overlay FP16 vs INT4 rescaled, color by label.
Ravi: Dumped top-20 mismatch cases into artifact. `ls /runs/harbor-lite/int4/per-channel/4482/artifacts` -> misretrievals.csv, sample_pairs.json, umap_plots.tar.gz.
bench-bot: Artifact uploaded: /runs/harbor-lite/int4/per-channel/4482/artifacts/misretrievals.csv
Ana: For docs: add a small calibration step in quant pipeline that stores median_norm and applies post-quant rescale by default for int4. note that this is cheap and avoids retraining.
Priya: Also try per-layer clip thresholds: some layers are heavier-tailed. `tools/quantize --per-layer-clip` helped previously.
Jules: If rescale helps consistently across datasets, include it in Optimize recommendations with a short note about checking recall@k delta after rescale.
Ravi: Queueing microbatch sweep and knn stability now. will report final summary once those complete. thanks all. :raised_hands:
